name: 26330 · Bridgeport, WV
findings: ZIP 26330 (Bridgeport) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 26330 (Bridgeport) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 26330 (Bridgeport) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
